explication: WorkerVless2sub is a Cloudflare Worker that builds VMess/VLESS/Trojan subscriptions from configured node details and preferred Cloudflare routes. The main workflow accepts a quick or custom subscription request, gathers eligible address sources, assembles nodes, and returns a client format; the Worker also serves a subscription-generation page. The README documents Clash/Sing-box conversion, dynamic UUIDs, and Telegram notifications. The source excerpt is partial, so links for unsampled routing and conversion details are based only on README documentation.
